name: Zippy Technology Corp.
summary: Zippy Technology Corp. designs, manufactures, and trades micro switches and power supplies in Taiwan, Mainland China, the United States, Germany, Italy and internationally. The company operates through Power Supply Division and Switch Division segments. It offers switches, such as waterproof switches, basic micro switches, rotary switches, push switches, low torque switches, slide switches, rocker switches, hook switches, slide DIP Switches, and diagnostic micro switches.
